Agreed update: treat the week‑2 lab + 3–5‑day telemedicine check as one safety package—if the lab is missing or the telemedicine occurs outside the 3–5‑day window (e.g., telemedicine on day 6), the system will auto‑flag and the default action is to trigger a dosing hold of up to 3 days until the package is complete; the PI may override the hold only with documented clinical justification (PI sign‑off required).

Borderline renal rule: borderline = values within ±10% of the new Arm C renal cutoff; values < (cutoff −10%) = clear screen‑fail (ineligible), values > (cutoff +10%) = proceed per routine randomization, and borderline results route to central review with a hard randomization hold until central clearance (24‑hour SLA).  
Systems action & cutover: systems will enable the dosing‑hold toggle, telemedicine template, shaded ±10% band, and central‑review queue by 18:00 today so these workflows are live at 00:00 local on 27‑Jul‑2026; sites must document any screenings initiated before cutover in the tracker.
